We propose Dialogue Act Script (DAS), a structured framework for encoding, localizing, and generating multilingual dialogues... We compare DAS-generated dialogues against both machine-translated and human-translated versions of the original English dialogues.

For automated evaluation, we computed BERTScore  to measure meaning retention, BLEU  to quantify lexical overlap, and ChrF++  to evaluate character-level and word-level similarity between the original and DAS-decoded texts.
